App.Title: Wayfinder
App.Subtitle: Build and level a character, one choice at a time
App.NoPending: Nothing left for Wayfinder to walk you through. Your character sheet may still have PF2E choices waiting on it.
App.FeedbackAria: Feedback. Report a problem or suggest an idea
App.FeedbackTooltip: Report a problem or suggest an idea
App.Guidance: Wayfinder walks you through ancestry, feats, class paths, spells, ability boosts, and skill increases. Anything it can't handle cleanly, it hands back to your character sheet.

Feedback.Title: Wayfinder feedback
Feedback.Heading: Tell me what happened
Feedback.Intro: Two ways to reach me. Pick whichever sounds closer. I'd rather get a rough report than none at all.
Feedback.ExternalTitle: These go to GitHub, and they're public
Feedback.ExternalBody: You'll need a free GitHub account to post, and anyone can read what you write. Opens in a new browser tab.
Feedback.BugHint: Something did the wrong thing, or nothing at all.
Feedback.FeatureHint: Something that would make building easier.
Feedback.Prefill: Your Wayfinder, Foundry, and PF2E versions are filled in for you.
Feedback.Privacy: Screenshots often catch player names and your world's invite link. Worth a look before you post.
Feedback.CoverageHint: If a step hands you back to the PF2E sheet, Wayfinder may simply not guide it yet.
Feedback.Discord: Prefer not to use GitHub? Find me on Discord as

ExtraPacks.Name: Extra PF2E compendium allowlist
ExtraPacks.Hint: Comma-separated compendium IDs or wildcards to search alongside the official PF2E packs. Use my-module.* for every compendium in one module, or * for every compendium installed.

CompendiumSources.Name: Wayfinder content sources
CompendiumSources.Label: Configure compendia
CompendiumSources.Hint: Choose which extra PF2E Item compendia Wayfinder searches, and see what character-building content each one holds.

EquipmentPolicy.Name: Starting equipment rules
EquipmentPolicy.Label: Configure equipment rules
EquipmentPolicy.Hint: Set which starting wealth options, equipment sources, rarity limit, and approvals Wayfinder uses.

SpellRarityCeiling.Name: Player max eligible rarity
SpellRarityCeiling.Hint: Spells at this rarity or below appear with no extra paperwork. Above it, a player has to write down where the access comes from, either a character or rules Access or permission from you. That note is the player's word, not something Wayfinder can verify. Set this to Unique and nothing needs a note. Tradition, rank, cantrip, curriculum, and fixed spell lists still apply.

EquipmentPolicy.Title: Starting equipment rules
EquipmentPolicy.Heading: Set your campaign's equipment rules
EquipmentPolicy.Intro: These are your campaign's rules. Nothing a player does in the builder widens them.
EquipmentPolicy.ActorOwnerChooses: The player picks from what you enable
EquipmentPolicy.PackFamiliesHint: Ticking a source only opens its Item compendia if PF2E's own pack and publication settings allow them too.
EquipmentPolicy.GmOnly: Only a GM can change equipment rules.
EquipmentPolicy.RecipeRequired: Turn on at least one starting wealth option.

CompendiumSources.Title: Wayfinder content sources
CompendiumSources.Heading: Choose extra compendia
CompendiumSources.Intro: Official PF2E content is always available. Turn on only the extra Item compendia your campaign uses.
CompendiumSources.Guidance: The counts below are raw document types. Some modules reuse ancestry, heritage, or class documents for companions and automation, so a big number doesn't always mean more player options. Wayfinder filters what a player can actually pick separately. Third-party content written as prose may still need your review or some setup by hand.
CompendiumSources.GlobalWildcardTitle: Every Item compendium is turned on
CompendiumSources.LegacyPatternTitle: Old wildcard sources need a look
CompendiumSources.LegacyPatternBody: Your current setting holds {patterns}. Whatever those match right now is ticked below. Saving swaps the patterns for the exact packs you approve, so a pack installed later won't switch itself on.
CompendiumSources.UnmatchedLegacyPatterns: Nothing installed matches these patterns right now. They stay ticked and saved until you clear them: {patterns}
CompendiumSources.SearchPlaceholder: Search name, module, or pack ID…
CompendiumSources.SourceUnavailable: This source isn't available right now
CompendiumSources.NoItemPacks: This world has no Item compendia.
CompendiumSources.SaveNote: Changing sources never strips items already on a character. A draft that used a source you just turned off may need another look.
CompendiumSources.GmOnly: Only a GM can change content sources.

Notifications.OwnerOnly: Only the character's owner can use Wayfinder on this sheet.
Notifications.MissingSelections: Finish the remaining steps before applying.
Notifications.NoPendingSteps: Nothing to apply. Check the PF2E sheet for any choices Wayfinder doesn't handle.
Notifications.DuplicateSelections: You can't pick the same option twice in one draft.
Notifications.Applied: Your choices are on the sheet.
Notifications.ApplyCancelled: Cancelled. Your draft is still here.
Notifications.ApplyFailed: Couldn't apply the changes. Your draft is intact. Take a look and try again.
